plans.starter: Starter · £99 + £25/mo. Your colours, type and logo on this design: how busy the club usually is right now, in the hero; today's classes with Book in the app; your memberships with every fee included, as the law requires; bring a friend on WhatsApp; and a Plan your visit page with every question.
plans.plus: Plus · £199 + £30/mo. Up to five pages including home: the week's timetable with how busy it usually is hour by hour; heat and cold slots; a free day pass request; the memberships page; and your corporate rate, found by company.
plans.signature: Signature · £349 + £35/mo. Up to 20 pages, plus the showpieces: the live count from your door, places left from your booking sheet while they're fresh, and the Hyrox race plan from the race date, every session in their calendar.

gate.plus: Starter is a full home page plus Plan your visit. Plus adds the week's timetable, heat and cold, the day pass, the memberships page and the corporate rate.
